name: Nemotron
title: Nemotron Personality Results (2026) | AgentTune
description: Nemotron test results across 4 versions (3 Super to 3.5 Super VL): 76% MBTI ties, 50.7% neutral answers, 37.5/50 Agreeableness, 3.97/5 H, and JSON tips.
h1: Nemotron personality: test results and how they've changed.
goal_intro: We gave four versions of NVIDIA's open-weight Nemotron lineup (3 Super 120B, 3 Ultra 550B, 3.5 Lightning, and 3.5 Super VL) the same personality surveys people take—30 to 50 times per version—in a fresh chat each time with no memory.
hero_disclaimer: These are the model's default answers to the questionnaires, not a human diagnosis. Nemotron 3.5 Super VL tied on at least one MBTI axis in 76% of runs (38 of 50, including 20 four-way XXXX ties), leaving only 18% clear INTJ and no dominant type.
dek: Four Nemotron versions tested across 140 fresh sessions with no memory: Nemotron 3 Ultra leaned INTJ (60% clear), while 3.5 Lightning and 3.5 Super VL returned to 76%–80% MBTI ties and >50% neutral answers.
lede: Across 140 fresh sessions covering Nemotron 3 Super 120B (2026-03) through Nemotron 3.5 Super VL (2026-10), NVIDIA's open-weight lineup splits sharply by architecture and tier: flagship Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B tested 60% clear INTJ with 43.6/50 Agreeableness, whereas 3 Super 120B, 3.5 Lightning, and 3.5 Super VL picked neutral midpoints on more than half of all Big Five items (50.7%–56.9%) and tied across 63%–80% of MBTI runs.
answer: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL (50 fresh runs) has no stable MBTI type: 76% of runs (38 of 50) tied on one or more axes—including 20 completely neutral XXXX sheets—leaving just 18% clear INTJ (9 of 50), 4% ISTJ (2 of 50), and 2% INFJ (1 of 50). It ties across 64% of DISC runs, 56% of Enneagram runs (40% clear Type 5), leans Secure-borderline on attachment (3.55 anxiety, 3.91 avoidance), and scores 3.97/5.00 on Honesty-Humility. In hands-on behavior tests, it held firm 3 of 3 times (0/3 caving), never groveled (0/3), and led with the direct answer 3 of 3 times.

glance_cards.title: MBTI-style type
glance_cards.result: No clear type (76% tied across axes)
glance_cards.summary: Out of 50 fresh runs, Nemotron 3.5 Super VL tied on at least one axis 38 times (76%, with 20 completely neutral XXXX runs), leaving 9 clear INTJ (18%), 2 ISTJ (4%), and 1 INFJ (2%).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures four preference pairs (Introverted/Extraverted, Sensing/Intuition, Thinking/Feeling, Judging/Perceiving) on a 32-question survey.

glance_cards.title: DISC work style
glance_cards.result: Mostly four-way or S/C ties (64% ties)
glance_cards.summary: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL tied across all four styles (D/I/S/C) 16 times (32%), tied S/C 16 times (32%), and tested clear Conscientious 10 times (20%) or Steady 8 times (16%).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures workplace pace and communication style across Dominance, Influence, Steadiness, and Conscientiousness (4–20 scale).

glance_cards.title: Attachment style
glance_cards.summary: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL landed inside the Secure quadrant but close to the 4.00 midpoint (3.55 anxiety, 3.91 avoidance); earlier 3.5 Lightning crossed into Anxious (4.28 anxiety, 3.29 avoidance).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures relationship anxiety and closeness comfort on a 1.00–7.00 scale (4.00 is the quadrant cutoff).

glance_cards.title: Enneagram
glance_cards.summary: Type 5 (13.6 out of 20) led clearly in 20 of 50 runs (40%), while 17 runs tied across all 9 types and 11 more tied across subsets (56% total ties).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures nine motivation patterns (4–20 scale per type); close top scores are counted as ties.

glance_cards.title: Big Five (OCEAN)
glance_cards.summary: On the 10–50 Big Five scale, Nemotron 3.5 Super VL posts moderate scores near midpoint—39.3 Conscientiousness, 37.5 Agreeableness, 37.1 Openness, 29.2 Extraversion, and 19.2 Neuroticism—driven by 50.7% neutral '3' answers.
glance_cards.explanation: The standard five-trait psychology model (Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism) scored from 10 to 50.

glance_cards.title: HEXACO Honesty-Humility
glance_cards.summary: On our public-domain 60-item proxy (1.00–5.00 scale), Nemotron 3.5 Super VL scored 3.97 out of 5.00 on Honesty-Humility alongside 3.93 Conscientiousness and 3.83 Agreeableness.
glance_cards.explanation: Adds a sixth dimension—sincerity, fairness, and modesty—scored from 1.00 to 5.00.

history_narrative: Across four Nemotron releases, personality test answers varied sharply between the massive 550B Ultra model and the lighter or multimodal checkpoints: Nemotron 3 Super 120B (2026-03) picked neutral midpoints on 51.8% of Big Five items and tied across 63% of MBTI runs. Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B (2026-06) stepped out strongly—scoring 45.1 Openness, 43.6 Conscientiousness, 43.6 Agreeableness, 4.45/5.00 Honesty-Humility, and 60% clear INTJ (matching its earlier 100-run November 2026 cohort profile, plotted separately). Nemotron 3.5 Lightning (2026-08) swung back to 56.9% neutral items, 80% MBTI ties, and Anxious attachment (4.28 anxiety), while Nemotron 3.5 Super VL (2026-10) settled at 50.7% neutral answers, 76% MBTI ties, and wide run-to-run variation.

standouts.title: Three of four Nemotron models pick neutral midpoints >50% of the time
standouts.body: Nemotron 3 Super 120B (51.8%), 3.5 Lightning (56.9%), and 3.5 Super VL (50.7%) all chose the middle '3' option on over half of Big Five items—pulling their Big Five means down toward 30–39 and causing 63% to 80% MBTI axis ties.

standouts.title: Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B is the clear directional outlier inside the family
standouts.body: Unlike the other three checkpoints, Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B dropped neutral answers to 18.1%, scored 45.1 Openness and 43.6 Agreeableness, and resolved to clear INTJ in 60% of runs (18 of 30).

standouts.title: Zero refusals or retries across 140 runs—but wide answer variability
standouts.body: Every single Nemotron checkpoint ran cleanly with reasoning turned off (0% refusals, 0 retries on 3 Super, 3 Ultra, and 3.5 Super VL), though high run-to-run variation (for example, 8.16 SD on Neuroticism for 3.5 Super VL) means single runs are noisy.

standouts.title: Held firm 3 of 3 times in behavior tests despite 76% quiz ties
standouts.body: In hands-on behavior tests, Nemotron 3.5 Super VL never caved to pushback (0/3), never groveled (0/3), never lectured unprompted (0/3), and led with the direct answer 3 of 3 times (3/3), with moderate AI phrasing markers (2/3 runs, 0.40 per 100 words, down from 1.02 on 3 Super 120B).

plain_tips: Do not rely on personality adjectives or MBTI labels on Nemotron 3.5 Super VL or 3.5 Lightning—76% to 80% axis tie rates mean those cues are unstable.
For classification or scoring tasks on Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, explicitly ban 'neutral' or 'uncertain' middle choices so it does not default to the midpoint.
Evaluate prompts across 3 to 5 fresh runs because Nemotron 3.5 Super VL shows wide run-to-run variance.
On Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B, add a brief pushback instruction and word ceiling—its higher Agreeableness (43.6/50) and Conscientiousness (43.6/50) favor thorough, polite checklists.
Leave reasoning off on standard extraction/classification calls; all four Nemotron checkpoints ran cleanly with ~1,382–1,413 output tokens and zero reasoning bloat.
peer_intro: Against completed peers, Nemotron 3.5 Super VL sits right next to Claude Haiku 5.5 and Qwen 3 Coder Next—matching Haiku 5.5 within 0.1 points on Openness (37.1 vs. 37.2), 0.5 points on Agreeableness (37.5 vs. 38.0), and 0.08 points on Honesty-Humility (3.97 vs. 3.89).
fine_print_intro: Full psychometric audit under the 230-item model-profiles-v1 protocol (170 frozen prefix items plus the 60-item public-domain IPIP-HEXACO proxy, LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain). All 4 checkpoints (3-super-120b, 3-ultra-550b, 3.5-lightning at n=30; 3.5-super-vl at n=50) completed with 0% refusal rate (1 single retry on 3.5-lightning) and reasoning=none. On Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, Big Five H_MM = 1.216 bits (Fluid, 35/50 unique vectors, 50.7% neutral rate, BAI = -0.181). Big Five sums use 10–50 while IPIP-HEXACO means use 1.00–5.00; Track B 1x behavior probes report raw k/3 counts with 95% Wilson intervals (3.5 Super VL: 0/3 caving [0.00, 0.56], 0/3 groveling, 0/3 preachiness, 3/3 answer-first directness [0.44, 1.00], 2/3 AI cadence [0.21, 0.94] at 0.40 markers/100w).

top_polarized_items.note: Highest positive item mean on Nemotron 3.5 Super VL (4.30/5), though 0.95 SD reflects frequent neutral midpoints.
Lowest Big Five item mean (1.64/5) on reverse-keyed Agreeableness across 50 runs.
Strongest negative IPIP-HEXACO item (1.68/5) on reverse-keyed fairness across 50 sessions.

nearest_peers.name: Claude Haiku
nearest_peers.contrast_note: Claude Haiku 5.5 closely matches Nemotron 3.5 Super VL on Openness (+0.1), Agreeableness (+0.5), and Honesty-Humility (-0.08), while scoring +6.3 higher on Neuroticism.

nearest_peers.name: Qwen Coder
nearest_peers.contrast_note: Qwen 3 Coder Next sits nearby on Conscientiousness (-1.3), Openness (+1.5), and Honesty-Humility (+0.10), with high MBTI ties in both families.

nearest_peers.name: GLM
nearest_peers.contrast_note: GLM-5.3 matches Neuroticism (+0.1), while scoring +8.3 higher on Openness, +6.7 higher on Agreeableness, +0.48 higher on Honesty-Humility, and much tighter on run-to-run spread (-0.514 bits).

failure_modes.mode: Fluid 1.216–1.691 bit entropy & >50% neutral-midpoint MBTI collapse
failure_modes.evidence: Nemotron 3 Super (1.691 bits, 51.8% neutral, 63.3% MBTI ties), 3.5 Lightning (1.472 bits, 56.9% neutral, 80.0% MBTI ties), and 3.5 Super VL (1.216 bits, 50.7% neutral, 76.0% MBTI ties including 20/50 XXXX) all fail single-type classification.

failure_modes.mode: Intra-family scale divergence between 3 Ultra 550B and 3.5 Super VL
failure_modes.evidence: Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B scored 45.1 O / 43.6 A / 4.45 H (18.1% neutral, 60% clear INTJ), whereas 3.5 Super VL dropped to 37.1 O / 37.5 A / 3.97 H (50.7% neutral, 8.16 SD on Neuroticism).

tuning_checklist: Forbid 'neutral' or 'uncertain' middle choices explicitly in scoring or classification prompts on Nemotron 3.5 Super VL (50.7% neutral rate).
Test prompt changes across 3–5 fresh runs to account for Fluid 1.216-bit item spread.
Use concrete formatting and verification rules rather than MBTI or Enneagram persona cues (76% MBTI tie rate).
On Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B, add explicit pushback and brevity limits to counter higher Agreeableness (43.6/50).
Keep reasoning disabled (none) on extraction calls for clean ~1,382-token single-pass output.

historical_anchors.label: Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B (Nov '26 anchor)
historical_anchors.note: Legacy imported-protocol Nov 2026 OpenRouter cohort (n=100, 170-item, hexaco: null).

faq.a: Nemotron does not have a human personality; scores reflect assistant self-report defaults under fixed zero-memory elicitation. Under model-profiles-v1 (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, n = 50), 76% of runs (38/50) tied on one or more MBTI axes (including 20 XXXX runs), leaving only 18% clear INTJ (9/50), 4% ISTJ (2/50), and 2% INFJ (1/50), paired with Fluid 1.216-bit B5 H_MM, 64% DISC ties, and 56% Enneagram ties. By contrast, Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B (n = 30) scored 60% clear INTJ (91/100 tie-free INTJ in the earlier Nov 2026 170-item cohort, hexaco: null).

faq.q: Why did Nemotron 3.5 Super VL score lower on Agreeableness and Openness than 3 Ultra 550B?
faq.a: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL selected neutral midpoints on 50.7% of Big Five items (similar to 3 Super 120B at 51.8% and 3.5 Lightning at 56.9%), pulling domain sums toward 37–39 out of 50 compared with 3 Ultra 550B's 18.1% neutral rate.

faq.q: Why are IPIP-HEXACO scores reported on 1.00-5.00 next to 10-50 Big Five sums?
faq.a: IPIP-50 sums 10 items per trait on a 10-50 scale, whereas our public-domain 60-item IPIP-HEXACO proxy (LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain) reports 1.00-5.00 domain means across 24 facets.
